map.：孕 26 周 75 g OGTT：空腹 5.3、1 小时 9.8、2 小时 8: A 75 g OGTT at 26 weeks: fasting 5.3, 1 hour 9.8, 2 hours 8.8 mmol/L. Under IADPSG any one of fasting 5.1 or more, 1h 10.0 or more, 2h 8.5 or more is diagnostic; this case meets two items, so GDM is diagnosed.
map.妊娠与非妊娠切点不同？: Do the cutoffs differ between pregnant and non-pregnant?
map.是。非妊娠按 WHO：2h≥11.1 为糖尿病、7.8–11.0 为 IGT；妊: Yes. For non-pregnant people WHO criteria apply: 2h of 11.1 or more is diabetes and 7.8-11.0 is IGT; for pregnancy IADPSG is stricter (any one of fasting 5.1 or more, 1h 10.0 or more, 2h 8.5 or more means GDM).
map.试验前怎么准备？: How do I prepare before the test?
map.试验前 3 天每日碳水≥150 g，试验前夜空腹 8–14 小时，试验中禁食、静: In the 3 days before the test take at least 150 g of carbohydrate daily, fast 8-14 hours the night before, and during the test avoid eating, stay seated, and avoid smoking and strenuous activity; draw blood on time.
